transform: Plot source J_ratio and speed_ratio × 100. Open lid normalized to 100%. Export physical values exactly from source strings. Round CV only for display.
boundary: Deterministic gas-side simulation at nominal 1 mL/min and finest tested 0.2 mm grid. Grid independence is not established. Nominal 100 µL fill and actual headspace are unverified. No biological, cell-shear or concentration-uniformity result is implied; circulation flux CV is not odor-concentration CV. No statistical error bars.
